n5538a32d8a.headline: The first Chinese train set for Leo Express heads to the Czech Republic. The Sirius train faces rigorous tests | Aktuálně.cz
n5538a32d8a.summary: Leo Express plans to deploy new Chinese-made Sirius train sets for long-distance connections starting mid-next year after rigorous testing in the Czech Republic.
n5538a32d8a.why: Leo Express is expanding its fleet with Chinese technology, reflecting growing international cooperation in rail transport and potential market competition.
